hunks.baseline: “Vile human. Who is that human?”
hunks.sol: “Vile human. Who is that?”

hunks.baseline: So there is one. A human with no sense of fear.
hunks.sol: So there was one after all—a human with no sense of fear.

hunks.baseline: I muttered inwardly and slowly looked around.
hunks.sol: I muttered to myself and slowly looked around.

hunks.baseline: The desolate outskirts were far from the center, abandoned by everyone. Even the light illuminating the city as brightly as day had yet to reach this place.
hunks.sol: We were deep in the deserted outskirts, far from the city center. Even the lights illuminating the city as brightly as day failed to reach this place.

hunks.baseline: And from among the ruins, a single person came walking out, casting a shadow.
hunks.sol: A lone figure emerged from among the ruins, casting a long shadow.

hunks.baseline: “There must be some kind of connection between us. We keep running into each other.”
hunks.sol: “We must be bound by fate somehow. We keep running into each other.”

hunks.baseline: “Not a connection. Bad blood.”
hunks.sol: “Not fate. An ill-fated bond.”

hunks.baseline: “Then what should we call the fact that we happened to meet in a place like this? Coincidence?”
hunks.sol: “Then what do you call meeting in a place like this? Coincidence?”

hunks.baseline: The answer that came back was as sharp as a blade.
hunks.sol: His answer was as sharp as a blade.

hunks.baseline: “Clear enough. So have you been following me around like a stray dog since earlier?”
hunks.sol: “Clear enough. Is that why you’ve been following me around like a stray dog?”

hunks.baseline: “When did you realize?”
hunks.sol: “When did you notice?”

hunks.baseline: “Since the Stone Age, you bastard. You stared at me so much that I thought you were going to bore holes in my face.”
hunks.sol: “Back in the Stone Age, you bastard. You were staring so hard, I thought you’d bore holes through my face.”

hunks.baseline: I had felt the gaze of someone secretly watching me immediately after I came out from examining the magic circle.
hunks.sol: I had sensed someone secretly watching me as soon as I left the magic-circle site.

hunks.baseline: It was an unpleasant, sticky gaze, completely different from the curious and admiring eyes of the others.
hunks.sol: It was an unpleasant, clinging gaze, completely different from the curiosity and admiration everyone else directed at me.

hunks.baseline: And at a time like this, there were very few people who would show hostility toward me.
hunks.sol: And under the current circumstances, very few people would be openly hostile toward me.

hunks.baseline: “Either you or those Crown Prince Party Chinese bastards. But the latter are too busy cleaning up the shit they’ve scattered everywhere… It was obvious, wasn’t it?”
hunks.sol: “It was either you or those Crown Prince Party Chinese bastards. But they’re too busy cleaning up the shit they left everywhere… So the answer was obvious, wasn’t it?”

hunks.baseline: That had clearly struck the mark, but there was not the slightest trace of surprise on Go Jun’s face.
hunks.sol: The words had clearly hit the mark, but Go Jun showed no surprise whatsoever.

hunks.baseline: “As expected. So that’s how it was.”
hunks.sol: “As expected. So you did notice.”

hunks.baseline: “I thought you would notice. Otherwise, you wouldn’t have left Magic Johnson behind and come all the way out here alone.”
hunks.sol: “I thought you would. Otherwise, you wouldn’t have left Magic Johnson behind and come all the way out here alone.”

hunks.baseline: Only then did I understand why Go Jun hadn’t been surprised. He had sent me a signal. A signal to follow him.
hunks.sol: Only then did I understand why Go Jun wasn’t surprised. He had deliberately sent me a signal—a signal to follow him.

hunks.baseline: This wasn’t surveillance, nor was it a lure. It was the scene both Go Jun and I had wanted.
hunks.sol: This wasn’t surveillance or a lure. This was exactly the situation both Go Jun and I had wanted.

hunks.baseline: Of course, the outcome of this meeting would be very different from what he expected.
hunks.sol: Of course, the outcome would be nothing like what he expected.

hunks.baseline: Go Jun didn’t wait for an answer. He stared straight at me and simply continued with what he had come to say.
hunks.sol: Go Jun didn’t wait for an answer. He stared straight at me and continued.

hunks.baseline: It was a short, simple question, but there was more than enough meaning packed inside it. I tilted my head and asked back with an innocent expression.
hunks.sol: It was a short, simple question, but the meaning behind it was unmistakable. I tilted my head and innocently asked,

hunks.baseline: “You don’t happen to think that I killed Uncle Jungryong, do you?”
hunks.sol: “You don’t actually think I killed Uncle Jungryong, do you?”

hunks.baseline: At the sound of Lee Jungryong’s name, Go Jun’s eyes shook violently. Without waiting for his answer, I covered my mouth with both hands.
hunks.sol: The moment he heard Lee Jungryong’s name, Go Jun’s eyes shook violently. Without waiting for his answer, I covered my mouth with both hands.

hunks.baseline: “My God, how could you have such a horrible thought? Are you serious?”
hunks.sol: “My God. How could you think something so horrible? Are you serious?”

hunks.baseline: “Stop that disgusting act. Do you think I’m asking because I don’t know?”
hunks.sol: “Enough of that disgusting act. Do you think I’m asking because I don’t know?”

hunks.baseline: “Then why are you asking? Didn’t you watch the press conference?”
hunks.sol: “Then why ask? Didn’t you watch the press conference?”

hunks.baseline: “I did. You spouted nothing but nonsense and lies from beginning to end.”
hunks.sol: “I did. You spouted nothing but lies and bullshit from beginning to end.”

hunks.baseline: Drops of blood fell from the fist he had clenched so tightly that it had turned white. Go Jun glared at me with eyes burning with rage.
hunks.sol: Blood fell from the fist he had clenched so tightly that his knuckles had gone white. Go Jun glared at me, his eyes blazing with rage.

hunks.baseline: “There are only two people here—you and me. Tell me the truth with your own mouth.”
hunks.sol: “There are only two people here—you and me. Tell me the truth with your own lips.”

hunks.baseline: “Vile human. How dare you leave this Atlanta-born Stone-King out of it!”
hunks.sol: “Vile human! How dare you leave out this Atlanta-born Stone-King!”

hunks.baseline: One more monster for the count.
hunks.sol: That made one more monster present.

hunks.baseline: More precisely, two people and one monster. Though I wasn’t sure whether the Skeleton King could still be called a monster.
hunks.sol: More precisely, there were two people and one monster. Though I wasn’t sure whether the Skeleton King could still be called a monster.

hunks.baseline: “Hm.”
hunks.sol: “Hmm.”

hunks.baseline: I scratched the back of my head while looking at Go Jun, then opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: I scratched the back of my head as I studied Go Jun, then said,

hunks.baseline: “Lee Jungryong and Wu Heixing. I took care of both of them. Those lunatics came up with a ridiculous scenario. They planned to kill only me without even touching the Arch Lich. And the result… You know what happened, right?”
hunks.sol: “Lee Jungryong and Wu Heixing. I took care of both of them. Those lunatics had cooked up a ridiculous scenario. They planned to kill me without laying a finger on the Arch Lich. And the result… Well, you know how that turned out.”

hunks.baseline: An assumption and the truth were two entirely different things.
hunks.sol: Suspecting the truth and hearing it confirmed were two entirely different things.

hunks.baseline: Even if he had already guessed the truth, hearing a definite answer from the mouth of his enemy was a completely different matter.
hunks.sol: Even if he had already guessed what happened, hearing the answer directly from his enemy’s mouth was another matter altogether.

hunks.baseline: I drove the final nail into the coffin for Go Jun, whose body was trembling violently.
hunks.sol: I drove the point home as Go Jun’s body trembled.

hunks.baseline: “They were that kind of people. What else was I supposed to do? I bought both of them tickets to the United States. Ah, I gave Uncle Jungryong first class.”
hunks.sol: “What else was I supposed to do with bastards like that? I bought them both tickets to the United States. Uncle Jungryong even got first class.”

hunks.baseline: “You—you dared to do that to him…!”
hunks.sol: “You… You dared do that to him…!”

hunks.baseline: The killing intent erupting from Go Jun’s entire body froze the air around us.
hunks.sol: Killing intent erupted from Go Jun’s entire body, freezing the air around us.

hunks.baseline: I stared at his fingers twitching toward the hilt of his sword, then abruptly opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: I stared at the fingers twitching toward his sword hilt, then spoke abruptly.

hunks.baseline: “What do you think you’re doing?”
hunks.sol: “What are you doing?”

hunks.baseline: Go Jun’s eyes widened. At the same time, the killing intent swirling around us vanished as if it had been washed away.
hunks.sol: Go Jun’s eyes flew wide open. At the same time, the killing intent swirling around us vanished without a trace.

hunks.baseline: No—it had been crushed beneath the wave of qi flowing from me.
hunks.sol: No—it had been crushed beneath the wave of qi pouring from me.

hunks.baseline: In the space where the dominant force had changed in an instant, I slowly began to walk.
hunks.sol: The balance of power shifted in an instant, and I slowly stepped forward.

hunks.baseline: “You’ve improved by leaps and bounds since the last time I saw you. If you think about it, you’re far better than Wu Heixing. Just what I’d expect from the Disciple Lee Jungryong trained at his side.”
hunks.sol: “You’ve improved by leaps and bounds since the last time I saw you. Come to think of it, you’re far better than Wu Heixing. Just what I’d expect from the Disciple Lee Jungryong kept by his side and trained himself.”

hunks.baseline: “With that said…”
hunks.sol: “But…”

hunks.baseline: With every step I took, Go Jun’s face grew paler.
hunks.sol: With each step I took, Go Jun’s face grew paler.

hunks.baseline: The gap between our powers was overwhelming. A rabbit could not defeat a tiger. The moment he made even the slightest movement to draw his sword, my teeth would sink into his neck.
hunks.sol: The gap between our powers was overwhelming. A rabbit could never defeat a tiger. The instant he moved to draw his sword, my teeth would sink into his neck.

hunks.baseline: “You should look at where you’re lying before you stretch out your legs. What are you doing, settling into a grave?”
hunks.sol: “You should check where you’re lying down before you stretch out your legs. Why would you settle into your own grave?”

hunks.baseline: Compressed air exploded from the tip of a finger I had raised leisurely.
hunks.sol: Compressed air exploded from the tip of the finger I had raised leisurely.

hunks.baseline: With a sharp crack, a single stream of Finger Qi shot toward Go Jun, who had frozen like a stone statue. And then—
hunks.sol: With a sharp crack, a stream of Finger Qi shot toward Go Jun, who stood frozen like a stone statue. Then—

hunks.baseline: It sent the sword strapped to his waist flying far into the distance.
hunks.sol: The sword strapped to his waist went flying into the distance.

hunks.baseline: Watching Go Jun’s frozen expression twist while his eyes remained wide open, I let out a short laugh.
hunks.sol: Go Jun’s rigid expression twisted, his eyes still wide. I let out a short laugh.

hunks.baseline: “If you want to die that badly, come more secretly and be ready to truly die. Don’t set up a half-assed trap like you did today.”
hunks.sol: “If you want to die that badly, be more discreet next time—and come prepared to actually die. Don’t set some half-assed trap like you did today.”

hunks.baseline: I thrust out my hand like lightning. Go Jun didn’t even have time to react.
hunks.sol: My hand shot out like lightning. Go Jun had no time to react.

hunks.baseline: The three streams of Finger Qi I fired pierced somewhere beyond the thick darkness. A moment later—
hunks.sol: Three more streams of Finger Qi pierced the thick darkness. A moment later—

hunks.baseline: Thud-thud-thud!
hunks.sol: Thud! Thud! Thud!

hunks.baseline: Three unconscious black shadows fell from the air in the distance, accompanied by faint impacts.
hunks.sol: Three unconscious figures in black dropped out of thin air in the distance.

hunks.baseline: Each one was a high-level Hunter who had trained in stealth abilities and concealed himself with various kinds of magic, but none of them could evade my Qi Sense, sharpened even further by the opening of my Middle Dantian.
hunks.sol: They were all high-level Hunters trained in stealth and concealed by various kinds of magic, but none of them could escape my Qi Sense, which had grown even sharper after the opening of my Middle Dantian.

hunks.baseline: “Were you secretly filming me, you hidden-camera bastard?”
hunks.sol: “What, were you filming me on the sly? You fucking hidden-camera creep.”

hunks.baseline: Clicking my tongue, I tapped Go Jun on the cheek. A voice full of spite slipped between his clenched teeth.
hunks.sol: Clicking my tongue, I patted Go Jun on the cheek. A spiteful voice slipped through his clenched teeth.

hunks.baseline: “We—the Ares Guild—will not fall. We will definitely avenge that person’s death…”
hunks.sol: “We—the Ares Guild—will not fall. We will avenge his death…”

hunks.baseline: Blood spattered together with teeth. I gripped Go Jun tightly by the collar and slapped him across the face again.
hunks.sol: A tooth flew out in a spray of blood. I seized Go Jun by the collar and slapped him again.

hunks.baseline: One more time.
hunks.sol: Once more.

hunks.baseline: Again.
hunks.sol: And again.

hunks.baseline: Rather than tearing through his bones and flesh, the internal energy in my palm burrowed into Go Jun’s body and rattled his brain.
hunks.sol: Instead of tearing through his bones and flesh, the internal energy carried in my palm burrowed into Go Jun and rattled his brain.

hunks.baseline: I grabbed the throat of Go Jun, who staggered helplessly, unable to keep his balance like a drunken man.
hunks.sol: He staggered like a drunk, unable to keep his balance. I grabbed him by the throat.

preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “Ghk!”
hunks.sol: “Ghk…!”

hunks.baseline: A bloody foam burst out with his groan and splattered across my face. An unfamiliar man was reflected in his unfocused eyes, his expression numb as he continued speaking.
hunks.sol: Bloody foam burst from his mouth with the groan and splattered across my face. Reflected in his unfocused eyes, an unfamiliar man continued in a numb voice.

hunks.baseline: The abilities possessed by superhumans called Hunters—or the power held by those with equivalent authority—allowed them to set the rules according to their own tastes and break them without hesitation. No matter what they did, they were never given a yellow card or a red card.
hunks.sol: Hunters possessed superhuman abilities, while others wielded equivalent authority. They made rules to suit themselves and broke them whenever they pleased. No matter what they did, no one ever showed them a yellow card or a red card.

hunks.baseline: When Lee Jungryong cut off Uncle Kkeokjeong’s arm to keep him in check, that had been perfectly natural to people like them. But—
hunks.sol: When Lee Jungryong cut off Uncle Kkeokjeong’s arm to keep him in check, people like them had considered it only natural.
But—

hunks.baseline: Now that a new referee had entered the game, the rules had to change as well. And the new rules were very simple.
hunks.sol: A new referee had stepped onto the field, so the rules had to change.
And the new rules were very simple.

hunks.baseline: I pressed Go Jun’s Mute Acupoint and muttered quietly.
hunks.sol: I pressed Go Jun’s Mute Acupoint and muttered,

hunks.baseline: I twisted both his arms and pulled with all my strength, as though wringing out laundry.
hunks.sol: I twisted both his arms like I was wringing out laundry, then pulled with all my strength.

hunks.baseline: With a horrible tearing sound, two arms came away from his body.
hunks.sol: With a sickening tear of flesh, both arms came free from his body.

hunks.baseline: An enormous amount of blood poured out, and the whites of his bulging eyes showed. A silent scream spilled from his mouth, its Mute Acupoint sealed.
hunks.sol: Blood gushed from the wounds, and his bulging eyes rolled back until only the whites showed. His Mute Acupoint kept the scream pouring from his mouth completely silent.

hunks.baseline: I shoved my fingers into the ragged stumps of his arms. The Scorching Yang Qi in my hand seared his flesh, inflicting even greater pain. I pinned down his writhing body and grabbed him by the ankles.
hunks.sol: I drove my fingers into the ragged stumps of his arms. The Scorching Yang Qi coursing through my hands seared his flesh, inflicting even greater pain. I pinned down his writhing body and seized his ankles.

hunks.baseline: The Strength in my body could grind even a thousand-geun boulder into powder. The bones forming both his legs shattered in an instant, splitting into hundreds of pieces.
hunks.sol: My Strength could reduce even a thousand-geun boulder to powder. The bones in both his legs shattered at once, breaking into hundreds of fragments.

hunks.baseline: He struggled without making a sound.
hunks.sol: His body thrashed soundlessly.

hunks.baseline: I poured internal energy into Go Jun’s body as he passed out from unimaginable pain.
hunks.sol: As Go Jun lost consciousness from the unimaginable pain, I poured internal energy into him.

hunks.baseline: When the light returned to his fading eyes, I smashed his shattered legs with my fist.
hunks.sol: Once the light returned to his fading eyes, I hammered my fist into his shattered legs.

hunks.baseline: By the time I finally stopped punching, what lay sprawled across the ground was no longer a human being but a large lump of meat.
hunks.sol: When I finally stopped, what lay sprawled across the ground was no longer a human being, but a large lump of meat.

hunks.baseline: The faint breath leaking from his nose and mouth was the only proof that he was still alive.
hunks.sol: The faint breath leaking from his nose and mouth was the only proof that he remained alive.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King, who had watched the entire scene from inside my Inventory, spoke in a trembling voice.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King, who had watched everything from inside my Inventory, spoke in a trembling voice.

hunks.baseline: I answered in a dry voice.
hunks.sol: I answered dryly.

hunks.baseline: “N-No, it’s just…”
hunks.sol: “N-No. It’s just…”

hunks.baseline: His voice trailed off, but I already knew what the Skeleton King wanted to say.
hunks.sol: His voice trailed off, but I already knew what he wanted to say.

hunks.baseline: The helplessness of being unable to do anything. Pain so unbearable that death would seem a hundred or a thousand times better.
hunks.sol: The helplessness of being unable to do anything. Pain so unbearable that death seemed a hundred—even a thousand—times preferable.

hunks.baseline: And the fear that they could find themselves in the same situation at any time if their opponent simply put his mind to it.
hunks.sol: And the fear that I could do the same thing to them anytime I wanted.

hunks.baseline: I needed to plant all of those things in the enemy’s heart and engrave them into his bones.
hunks.sol: I needed to plant all of that in my enemy’s heart and carve it into his bones.

hunks.baseline: Of course, there was another option that would leave the fewest loose ends.
hunks.sol: Of course, there was another option that would leave far fewer loose ends.

hunks.baseline: The tips of my fingers twitched before I realized it.
hunks.sol: My fingertips twitched before I realized it.

hunks.baseline: If I applied just a little—just a tiny bit more—force, I could kill Go Jun.
hunks.sol: With just a little more force—only a tiny bit—I could kill Go Jun.

hunks.baseline: It was the perfect opportunity to eliminate even the slightest possibility.
hunks.sol: This was the perfect opportunity to eliminate even the slightest possibility of future trouble.

hunks.baseline: The doubts surrounding the truth would not disappear.
hunks.sol: Doubts surrounding the truth never disappeared completely.

hunks.baseline: The conspiracy theory that humanity’s first trip to the moon was a lie, and the conspiracy theories claiming that countless famous people recorded in history were still alive, all followed the same pattern.
hunks.sol: Conspiracy theories claimed that humanity had never landed on the moon, or that countless famous figures recorded as dead were actually still alive. This was no different.

hunks.baseline: If Lee Jungryong disappeared, followed by Wu Heixing and then Go Jun as well—and if it came to light that I had “happened” to be here at exactly the right time—the rumors surrounding me would no longer be conspiracy theories.
hunks.sol: If Lee Jungryong disappeared, followed by Wu Heixing and then Go Jun—and it came to light that I had “coincidentally” been here at exactly the right time—the rumors surrounding me would cease to be mere conspiracy theories.

hunks.baseline: So I had to end it here.
hunks.sol: So this was where I had to stop.

hunks.baseline: Right now, after planting fear of me and the overwhelming gap between our powers.
hunks.sol: Now, after showing him the overwhelming gap between our powers and planting the fear of me deep inside him.

hunks.baseline: Go Jun’s body flinched. In a voice lower and more emotionless than ever, I bit out each word one by one.
hunks.sol: Go Jun’s body flinched. In a voice lower and more emotionless than ever, I bit out every word.

hunks.baseline: “Let it end with Lee Jungryong. No one else.”
hunks.sol: “Let it end with Lee Jungryong alone.”

hunks.baseline: My breath, hot as lava, touched his body, and the figure lying facedown began to convulse.
hunks.sol: My breath, hot as lava, brushed against him, and his prone body convulsed.

hunks.baseline: Like a rabbit sensing the tiger’s teeth digging into its neck.
hunks.sol: Like a rabbit feeling a tiger’s teeth sink into its neck.

hunks.baseline: “Hide your teeth. Hide your claws. If you do that… nothing will happen.”
hunks.sol: “Hide your teeth. Sheathe your claws. If you do that… nothing will happen.”

hunks.baseline: If he had intended to kill, he should have been prepared to die.
hunks.sol: If he had set out to kill, he should have been prepared to die.

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong had been my greatest enemy and obstacle, and in the end, he had paid the price for what he had done.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong had been my greatest enemy and obstacle. In the end, he had paid the price for what he had done.

hunks.baseline: What I was offering now was a proposal of reconciliation.
hunks.sol: What I was offering now was a chance to make peace.

hunks.baseline: His head gave the faintest nod.
hunks.sol: His head moved in the faintest nod.

hunks.baseline: As I stared into his two eyes drenched in fear and terror, I pressed his Sleep Acupoint, took several high-grade potions from my Inventory, and poured them over his body.
hunks.sol: I stared into his eyes, drenched in fear and dread, then pressed his Sleep Acupoint. After taking several high-grade potions from my Inventory, I poured them over his body.

hunks.baseline: I watched him heal rapidly, then suddenly turned my head.
hunks.sol: I watched his wounds rapidly heal, then suddenly turned my head.

hunks.baseline: At that moment, a layer of space peeled away, revealing a huge Black man. Magic Johnson looked at me with a complicated expression before opening his mouth.
hunks.sol: At that moment, a layer of space peeled away, revealing a huge Black man. Magic Johnson regarded me with a complicated expression before speaking.

hunks.baseline: “I think there’s a lot we need to talk about.”
hunks.sol: 「I think we have a lot to talk about.」

hunks.baseline: “That’s a gay bar, dumbass.”
hunks.sol: *That place is a gay bar, dumbass.*
